name: images
description: Draws pictures in the terminal transcript where the terminal speaks the kitty graphics protocol (kitty, Ghostty): what Read returns for a PNG, JPEG or GIF, the image blocks of MCP tool results, and images pasted into a prompt; their name and size elsewhere. A click hides a picture; its caption shows it again.

maxRows.title: Picture height
maxRows.description: The most terminal rows a picture takes, its caption included, from 2 to 256. A short terminal gives a picture half its height at most.
